{{Quote|I was sent here with other commandos…and quickly realized I wanted out.|CC-5576 "Gregor"|<ref name="War-Mantle" />}}
An Imperial '''clone commando''' served the [[Galactic Empire]] during the early [[Standard day|days]] of the [[Imperial Era]]. As the [[Imperial Military]] planned to transition from a [[Cloning|clone army]] to a conscription-based force under [[Project War-Mantle]], this [[clone commando]] was part of a group of 50 clone [[commando]]s sent to the [[Imperial Base on Daro]] to train non-clone [[human]] [[soldier]]s as eventual replacements for [[clone trooper|clone stormtroopers]]. The base was [[Extraction on Daro|infiltrated]] by [[Clone Force 99]]<ref name="War-Mantle" /> in [[19 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' places the events of [[The Bad Batch Season 1|''The Bad Batch'' Season 1]] in [[19 BBY]].</ref> shortly after [[Clone Captain]] [[Gregor|CC-5576]] "Gregor" was arrested for [[Treason|desertion]]. This commando attempted to prevent the renegade clone [[squad]] from escaping through the facility's [[thermal exhaust port]], but was inadvertently shot by a group of [[TK stormtrooper]]s under his command. The commando took several [[blaster]] shots to the chest and consequently fell down the mountainside of the Daro base and to the [[planet]]'s surface.<ref name="War-Mantle" />

==Biography==
In 19 BBY, the unidentified Imperial clone commando was stationed on the Imperial Base on Daro to serve as an instructor for the first thousand TK stormtroopers recruited by the Galactic Empire. When the rogue clones of Clone Force 99 infiltrated the facility to extract the mutinous commando CC-5576 "Gregor", the unidentified commando was patrolling the facility's halls with a squad of TK stormtroopers and was alerted to the security breach. The commando noticed that the renegade clones were attempting to escape through the facility's reactor port and reported his findings before pursuing them with his squad. As the rogue clones attempted to flee on their vessel, the ''[[Marauder (Omicron-class)|Marauder]]'', the Imperial clone commando and his squad spotted them and pinned the squad down at the end of the reactor port. As his squad continued to fire, the commando charged forward and engaged in hand-to-hand combat with the rogue clones, but was quickly disarmed and restrained. As the commando broke free, he stepped into a barrage of blaster fire from his own troopers. After sustaining several shots to the chest, the commando reeled backwards and fell down the mountainside of the Daro base screaming.<ref name="War-Mantle">{{TBB|War-Mantle}}</ref>

==Equipment==
The clone commando wore [[Katarn-class commando armor|''Katarn''-class Commando Armor]] and was armed with a [[DC-15A blaster carbine]].<ref name="War-Mantle" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|They're escaping through the reactor port!|The commando's last words|<ref name="War-Mantle" />}}
The [[clone commando]] first appeared in "[[War-Mantle]]," the fourteenth episode of ''[[Star Wars: The Bad Batch]]''. He was voiced by [[Dee Bradley Baker]].<ref name="War-Mantle" />
